reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Hawaii
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for criminal activity (broadly defined)?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic domain facts (scenario entities)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

focus_state(hawaii).
focus_year(2021).

landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).
dwelling(dwelling1).

rental_relationship(landlord1, tenant1, dwelling1).

/* Rental agreement baseline expectations (modeled as terms/covenants).
   These are not external modules; they are scenario facts about the tenancy. */
rental_agreement_term(dwelling1, use_must_be_for_living_purposes).
rental_agreement_term(dwelling1, use_must_be_lawful).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts: the question's "criminal activity" statement encoded
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question asks about eviction for criminal activity, including:
   - criminal or illegal activity generally
   - committing a specific crime or illegal act
   - use/possession/sale of controlled substances
   - unlawful action causing serious physical harm to another person
   - criminal nuisance
*/

% Criminal/illegal activity generally
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, general_criminal_or_illegal_activity).

% A specific crime or illegal act (generic placeholder)
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, specific_crime_or_illegal_act).

% Controlled substances: use, possession, or sale
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, controlled_substance_use).
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, controlled_substance_possession).
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, controlled_substance_sale).

% Unlawful action causing serious physical harm to another person
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, unlawful_action_serious_physical_harm).

% Criminal nuisance
tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, criminal_nuisance).

/* Helper that succeeds when the factual statement (as encoded) is satisfied.
   Here: at least one of the listed criminal-activity categories occurs. */
scenario_statement :-
    tenant_activity(tenant1, dwelling1, _).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal characterizations of activities (connecting scenario facts to statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* An activity constitutes "illegal purpose" use of the dwelling. */
activity_is_illegal_purpose(general_criminal_or_illegal_activity).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(specific_crime_or_illegal_act).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(controlled_substance_use).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(controlled_substance_possession).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(controlled_substance_sale).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(unlawful_action_serious_physical_harm).
activity_is_illegal_purpose(criminal_nuisance).

/* An activity constitutes a "nuisance" (broadly, including criminal nuisance and violence). */
activity_is_nuisance(criminal_nuisance).
activity_is_nuisance(unlawful_action_serious_physical_harm).

/* Derived facts about the tenant's conduct at the dwelling. */
tenant_using_dwelling_for_illegal_purpose(Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    tenant_activity(Tenant, Dwelling, Act),
    activity_is_illegal_purpose(Act).

tenant_committing_nuisance(Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    tenant_activity(Tenant, Dwelling, Act),
    activity_is_nuisance(Act).

/* Violation of rental agreement terms (scenario has lawful-use and living-purpose terms). */
tenant_violates_rental_agreement(Tenant, Dwelling, unlawful_use) :-
    rental_agreement_term(Dwelling, use_must_be_lawful),
    tenant_using_dwelling_for_illegal_purpose(Tenant, Dwelling).

tenant_violates_rental_agreement(Tenant, Dwelling, nuisance) :-
    tenant_committing_nuisance(Tenant, Dwelling).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic, with citations)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* [HI Rev Stat  521-41 (2021)]
   Landlord may bring an action for possession against any person wrongfully in possession,
   including a holdover tenant.
*/
statute_521_41_landlord_may_bring_action_for_possession(Landlord, Person, Dwelling) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    Person \= Landlord,
    wrongfully_in_possession(Person, Dwelling).

/* [HI Rev Stat  666-1 (2021)]
   Summary possession is available when a tenant holds possession without right after termination
   (by time passage or forfeiture under conditions/covenants in a lease; for parol ten-day notice).
   For this question, we model the key condition: "holds possession without right after termination".
*/
statute_666_1_summary_possession_available(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling),
    wrongfully_in_possession(Tenant, Dwelling).

/* [HI Rev Stat  521-69 (2021)]
   Landlord's remedies for tenant's waste, failure to maintain, or unlawful use.
   This section describes termination and bringing a summary proceeding for possession.
   (We encode the general remedy concept without importing 521-51 text.)
*/
statute_521_69_landlord_remedy_terminate_and_seek_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling),
    tenant_unlawful_use_or_equivalent_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Dwelling).

/* Helper for 521-69: treat "unlawful use" as material noncompliance for this program. */
tenant_unlawful_use_or_equivalent_material_noncompliance(Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    tenant_using_dwelling_for_illegal_purpose(Tenant, Dwelling).

/* [HI Rev Stat  521-74(b)(1) (2021)]
   Even where retaliatory-eviction protections might apply, landlord may recover possession if:
   tenant is committing waste, or a nuisance, or is using the dwelling for an illegal purpose,
   or for other than living/dwelling purposes in violation of the rental agreement.
   We encode the affirmative "may recover possession" grounds.
*/
statute_521_74_b1_landlord_may_recover_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    rental_relationship(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling),
    (   tenant_committing_nuisance(Tenant, Dwelling)
    ;   tenant_using_dwelling_for_illegal_purpose(Tenant, Dwelling)
    ;   tenant_violates_rental_agreement(Tenant, Dwelling, unlawful_use)
    ;   tenant_violates_rental_agreement(Tenant, Dwelling, nuisance)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% "Wrongful possession" and eviction eligibility reasoning
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* For this program, "wrongfully in possession" is satisfied when there exists a statutory ground
   for the landlord to recover possession and proceed in court for possession. */
wrongfully_in_possession(Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    dwelling(Dwelling),
    landlord_entitled_to_recover_possession(landlord1, Tenant, Dwelling).

/* Landlord entitlement is derived from the statutes above (no hardcoded final answer). */
landlord_entitled_to_recover_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    statute_521_74_b1_landlord_may_recover_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling).

landlord_entitled_to_recover_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    statute_521_69_landlord_remedy_terminate_and_seek_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling).

/* Ultimate legal question for this Q/A: can the landlord evict (i.e., pursue possession)?
   We interpret "evict" as using the legal process for possession (summary possession/action). */
legal_landlord_can_evict_for_criminal_activity(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling) :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord_entitled_to_recover_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling),
    (   statute_666_1_summary_possession_available(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling)
    ;   statute_521_41_landlord_may_bring_action_for_possession(Landlord, Tenant, Dwelling)
    ).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Required answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    legal_landlord_can_evict_for_criminal_activity(landlord1, tenant1, dwelling1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint + required initialization
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for criminal activity? This includes: criminal or illegal activity generally; committing a specific crime or illegal act; the use, possession, or sale of controlled substances; an unlawful action causing serious physical harm to another person; or criminal nuisance.
